items.title: Reject non-English (CJK) author artifacts at story_create and background_set
items.context: Reuse the EXISTING CJK-detection from packages/main/src/handlers/english-artifact-gate.ts: export a shared containsCJK(text) predicate and call it in story_create (story-create.ts) and background_set/background_append (background.ts) to REFUSE non-English author-controlled content BEFORE it is persisted. story_create scans the author-provided background + each checklist item title/context/userSees + title/description; background_set/append scans the provided content. On CJK, refuse with a clear field-named message (e.g. 'story_create refuses: non-English (CJK) text in background (<section>):<line>. Story artifacts must be English. Found: <snippet>. [english_artifact_cjk_authoring]') and do NOT create the story / write the file. The early check must use the SAME predicate as runEnglishArtifactGate so the at-create check and the REVIEW->TEST gate AGREE. Limit the scan to author-controlled artifacts only; never code or runtime files. Common English punctuation (U+2014 em-dash etc.) must NOT be flagged. Reference impl in scratch /tmp/s4-cjkcreate.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/cli.js story_create ... with CJK in the background or a checklist item is REFUSED with 'story_create refuses: non-English (CJK) text in <field> (<section>):<line>. Story artifacts must be English. Found: <snippet>.' and no story dir is created. background_set with CJK content is refused before writing. An all-English story_create (including em-dash) succeeds normally.

happy.desc: smoke: story_create with CJK in the background is REFUSED and NO story dir is created; WHY: fail at authoring, not at REVIEW->TEST
smoke: story_create with CJK in a checklist item title/context is REFUSED (no story dir); WHY: checklist artifacts also gated
smoke: an all-English story_create succeeds (incl. U+2014 em-dash NOT flagged as CJK); WHY: no false positive

edge.desc: smoke: background_set / background_append with CJK content is REFUSED before writing background.md; WHY: the other author entry point is gated too
the at-create check uses the SAME containsCJK predicate as runEnglishArtifactGate (assert agreement); WHY: early check and gate never disagree

adversarial.desc: the scan is limited to author-controlled artifacts and never flags code/runtime files or rejects legitimate English; WHY: no over-reach
no second/duplicated CJK regex is introduced — the predicate is exported once and reused; build + lifecycle-registry-contract pass; WHY: single source of truth

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke: story_create with CJK in the background is REFUSED (english_artifact_cjk_authoring) and NO story dir is created — fail at authoring, not at REVIEW->TEST.
Smoke: story_create with CJK in a checklist item title AND context is REFUSED and no story dir is created — checklist artifacts are gated too.

Smoke: an all-English story_create INCLUDING a U+2014 em-dash SUCCEEDS and persists the em-dash — no false positive (detectCjk only matches CJK ranges; em-dash/smart-quotes/accented-Latin not flagged).
Smoke: background_set with CJK content is REFUSED before writing — background.md is byte-identical before/after the refused call (the other author entry point is gated too).

Smoke agreement assertion: across ascii / em-dash / cjk-core / cjk-ext-A, the early check (findFirstEnglishAuthoringViolation), runEnglishArtifactGate, and the shared containsCJK all return the SAME verdict — the at-create check and the REVIEW->TEST gate use the same detectCjk and can never disagree.

The scan is limited to author-controlled artifacts (background, checklist title/context/userSees, title, description); it does not scan code/runtime files and does not reject legitimate English — confirmed by the all-English+em-dash success case and the scoped hook points.

No second/duplicate CJK regex: the new assertEnglishAuthoringText/containsCJK helpers wrap the existing detectCjk (core/cjk-detect.ts via scanText) that the REVIEW->TEST gate already uses — single source of truth; build 0 and lifecycle-registry-contract 0 divergences.
